objectives: Explain the call of Abram out of his country and kindred.
Identify who is blessed through Abraham's seed.
Describe how the Most High protected Abram's household in Egypt.
takeaways: When the Most High calls you out, you have to go; do not let your kindred hold you back (Isaiah 51:2).
Confessing Christ before men means something, even if it sets you at variance with your household (Matthew 10:32-37).
In thee shall all families be blessed is not everybody: scattered Israel gets the chance to repent and return (Acts 3:25-26).
The Lord plagued Pharaoh's house because of Sarai and protected Abram's household.
